QuestInfo.0: You can learn more about the Reclamation HQ operation from #bPiston#k in the #bReclamation HQ Commander Barracks#k.
QuestInfo.1: Piston said the Battle Hounds are the reason for the ambush by the Specters in the HQ region. He asked that you defeat #r30 #o2400106##k enemies.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Specter Battle Hounds.

0.0: We managed to hold off the Specters with the #bhelp of you Maple-Worlders#k. Now's the perfect time for a counterattack. You ready?

0.2: I heard the Specter army has #o2400107# monsters ready to go, and are mass-producing #r#o2400106##k monsters. The #o2400106# monsters are the scouts deployed near the HQ front lines!
0.3: Please defeat as many of those mutts as you can! At least #r30#k! \r\n#e#r* If you accept, you will move to the field.#k\r\n
